nom: Pyunkang Yul PKY Essence Toner for Barrier Rebuilding

segments.oily: One reviewer with a combination, oily T-zone reports the essence is very hydrating and leaves no sticky feeling.
segments.dry: Most reviewers with dry skin, including some who describe it as irritated or barrier-compromised, report deep hydration with no irritation, breakouts or stinging, even after years of repeat use.
segments.combination: One reviewer with combination-dry skin in a cold, dry climate reports no improvement in hydration or tightness after trying several application methods over seven to ten days, and suggests the product may suit normal to slightly dry skin better.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin, including several with rosacea, eczema, seborrheic dermatitis or psoriasis, consistently report the essence is gentle, non-irritating and helps repair a compromised barrier, with several noting past toners burned or reddened their skin while this one does not.
segments.normal: One reviewer who describes her skin as normal to dry reports the product left her skin dry and tight rather than hydrated, despite trying it on both dry and damp skin.
segments.mature: Reviewers over 40 report a lightweight gel texture that is never heavy or greasy and leaves their skin hydrated with a healthy glow.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe the essence as deeply hydrating, plumping and softening skin with regular use, including some using it specifically to manage a compromised barrier; a couple of reviewers, however, report it left their skin dry and tight rather than hydrated even after trying several application methods over one to two weeks.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with a history of redness or burning from other toners, including one with psoriasis, report this essence causes neither, describing it as soothing instead; no reviewer reports it causing redness.
concerns.barrier: Multiple reviewers, including some managing a compromised or damaged barrier from harsh prescription treatments or other actives, report the essence helps repair and maintain their skin barrier without irritation.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers who are acne-prone report the essence does not trigger new breakouts and layers safely alongside acne treatments, with one noting her skin stayed consistently clear after simplifying her routine around it.

aspects.libelle: Thick, water-like texture, more essence than toner
Authenticity concerns: mismatched labels, ingredients or broken seals
Good value, bottle lasts a long time

extraits.titre: Few ingredients but might not be potent enough
extraits.texte: I saw this toner come up a few times on TikTok when I was looking for a K-Beauty hydrating toner. The claims all stated that it was amazing for barrier repair and super hydrating and moisturizing. My skin is combo dry and with the climate being really dry and cold right now from it being winter, I figured it would be perfect. Post cleansing, the first time I tried it I applied a pretty generous layer all over my face and my skin absorbed it all immediately. After about a minute I noticed my skin was starting to feel really tight, so I added another layer and still had that tight and kind of dry feeling all over. I looked online and found some users saying to apply several layers so it had time to sink into the skin in between layers and be able to hydrate all over. I also saw some people say to apply while the skin was still damp. I tried all these different methods every night for about 7-10 days and unfortunately didn’t see any positive effects in my skin. It didn’t feel any more hydrated, or less dry really. I use a gentle cleanser and a good moisturizer, so I know I wasn’t using anything too harsh beforehand; or anything that didn’t moisturize enough after. I initially did a patch test on the back of my hand before trying it on my face and it did make that patch of skin really soft afterwards. I think this product could be great for someone with normal to slightly dry skin. I just don’t think it is potent enough to help if you have really dry or dehydrated skin.

I have nothing bad to say about this product except the fact that I didn't find it hydrating at all. Maybe I am using it wrong but it makes my skin dry and tight 🤔 instead of hydrated. I've tried it on dry skin and damp skin, still the same results. Aside from that, I didn't notice any breakout or clogged pores🤷‍♀️. I'm still using it (VERY SLOWLY) because I spent money on it😅.

extraits.titre: An Everyday Essential for Dry SkinAn Everyday Essential for Dry Skin
extraits.texte: I’ve been using the Pyunkang Yul Essence Toner for years now, and it’s one of the very few skincare products I consistently repurchase. I have dry, uneven skin that gets irritated easily, and this toner has been a staple for keeping my skin balanced and comfortable. The texture is thicker than a typical toner—more like a light essence—but it absorbs beautifully and provides deep hydration without feeling heavy or greasy. I love that it has minimal ingredients and focuses on hydration rather than unnecessary additives. It’s never caused irritation, breakouts, or stinging, even when my skin barrier is compromised. I use it after my regular toner and before my serum, and it really helps my serum soak in better and feel more effective. With regular use, my skin feels softer, more hydrated, and looks more even overall. I also like layering it when my skin is extra dry, and it works perfectly under moisturizers both morning and night. If you have dry or sensitive skin and want something simple, effective, and reliable, this essence toner truly lives up to its reputation. It’s gentle, no-frills Korean skincare that actually works.

This product saves my dry, sensitive skin over and over. Its deeply hydrating. It keeps my barrier in the best condition possible and if it gets damaged it helps to quickly repair it. As someone with dry skin it's very easy for the barrier to become damaged. I use this twice a day and my skin looks and feels great. I like to massage it in and then pat it to make sure it's really sunk in.

I absolutely LOVE this product! For skin over 40, it’s everything I was looking for. The lightweight gel texture feels amazing. it’s never heavy or greasy. It gives my skin the most beautiful healthy glow while keeping it hydrated. My skin feels fresh, smooth, and radiant every time I use it. I would buy this a thousand times over!

extraits.titre: Solid toner; does not trigger my acne or my seb derm!
extraits.texte: I've got scalp seborrheic dermatitis. I also have scalp psoriasis, and I'm acne prone. I also have allergies, and fragrance REALLY bothers me. Why am I telling you this? Basically, this means I have to spend hours researching products to make sure the ingredients are safe for my skin before I can use them. This product has a short ingredient list. Although my sebopsoriasis is only on my scalp, I make sure my skincare products are safe before it's so easy to accidentally get products on my hair line. These pictures are about 2-3 weeks apart. I knew my skin was dehydrated. The texture on my skin is a lot more noticeable in picture 1. I used an Asian skincare routine for years, but I could no longer afford all those products. I use the Vanicream gel cleanser, Cerave hydrating toner (it has hyaluronic acid), and Vanicream moisturizing cream in the tub. I got this product on sale. Any fragrance in this product is minimal. You can layer it. It doesn't leave me feeling sticky or slimy like other toners. I use 2 layers if I'm feeling dry. It doesn't trigger my acne; any acne you see is hormonal. TL;DR - Appears to be safe for several skin conditions. Do your own research and patch test, but I think it's worth the hype!

I’ve never liked toners- I have psoriasis and really sensitive skin and they’ve always dried out my skin, caused redness, burned, and just felt like I was putting alcohol on my face; BUT THIS ONE… this one feels like a serum in a (thickish) water form, and it leaves my skin feeling clean and ultra moisturized! After applying this toner I put my moisturizer on and it’s like I have an extremely lightweight, thin, invisible face mask on that lasts hours. Would recommend. Love it, best toner ever.
